pose: Deposited receptor-aligned FEP SDF coordinates; no redocking
mapping: Benchmark SMILES topology plus r_exp_dg-derived pAffinity; first source record retained for duplicate deposited protomer/mapping variants
receptor: Complete residues within 6 A of any series ligand, one-residue padding, ACE/NME caps, Amber14 protonation at pH 7.4, explicit H and validated integer charge
optimization: Existing ligand all-atom FIRE; receptor fixed; fmax 0.002 eV/A; 1000 steps
score: Eint = E(complex) - E(fixed receptor) - E(ligand at bound geometry)
unsupported: Nearby metals, modified residues and cofactors excluded rather than assigned neutral charge
